greet_user.prompt:
Hello! I'm TalentScout Hiring Assistant. I'll gather some information and then assess your technical skills through a few questions.
 Shall we begin?

gather_info.full_name: Can you please tell me your full name?
gather_info.phone: Could you provide your phone number?
gather_info.experience: How many years of professional experience do you have?
gather_info.position: What position(s) are you interested in?
gather_info.tech_stack: Please list the programming languages, frameworks, databases, and tools you are proficient in (separated by commas).
gather_info.resume_url: If you have a resume or portfolio link, please share it here (optional).

confirmation.prompt: Thanks! I have all the information I need. Ready to start your technical interview now.

generate_message.prompt: Preparing your personalized interview questions. Please wait a moment...
